fact: The UK Home Office guidance says Eritrea issues national ID cards, which are required for an Eritrean passport.
The US State Department says Eritrea began issuing new plastic national identity cards with the holder's fingerprint in late 2015 for people over 18, though very few are in circulation.
The Eritrean embassy in Washington says Eritreans aged 18 or above must obtain a national ID and describes how new and replacement IDs are issued.
